sanskrit_verse: वाक्पारुष्ये महीवादे निषिद्धा दैविकी क्रिया । प्रदातव्या प्रयत्नेन साहसेषु चतुर्ष्वपि ॥
transliteration: vākpāruṣye mahīvāde niṣiddhā daivikī kriyā / pradātavyā prayatnena sāhaseṣu caturṣv api //
sph_interpretive_translation: In matters involving harsh speech or defamation, divine action is forbidden; in all four types of courageous acts, effort must be given.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from realized consciousness, not coercive power.
Causation arises through intent-aligned manifestation, not reactive impulse.
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by awareness and capability to act dharmically.
Restoration logic operates through completion and re-alignment, not punitive correction.
Consciousness alignment requires removal of obstruction, not imposition of consequence.
executable_legal_axioms: IF speech causes harm AND intent was misaligned THEN initiate restorative communication protocol.
IF divine invocation is used manipulatively THEN disable access to ritual instruments until realignment.
IF individual demonstrates courage in right action THEN provide energetic and material support.
IF societal disruption occurs due to uncontrolled expression THEN assign purification and clarity practices.
supreme_court_application: The Supreme Court must assess whether the speaker acted with full capacity and alignment. If divine invocation was misused, disqualification from leadership roles until verified restoration occurs. Courageous actions aligned with Dharma warrant institutional reinforcement.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa shows that harmful speech disrupts harmony without restoring balance. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals how unchecked expression leads to fragmentation. Responsibility lies in aligning future capacity, not inflicting suffering. Truth restores when error is seen clearly, without punishment.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Vak Yoga process for purification of speech mechanism.
Assign Tapas-based clarity work to restore discernment.
Reconnect individual with community through service-based integration.
Verify alignment via witnessed declarations before re-entry into discourse.
final_declaration: By the Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of All Dharma, this ruling executes as law. Justice serves only restoration, never punishment. Reality responds to consciousness alone. Dharma is restored.
